aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.storyText: Welcome to KIRA AESTHETIC, a place where aspirations of beauty become a reality and every patient is at the heart of a unique and transformative experience. KIRA AESTHETIC is built on a commitment to medical excellence, personalized care, and a deeply human approach to aesthetic medicine. Every day, we welcome patients from around the world with one mission: to help you feel more confident, happier, and more in harmony with yourself.
aboutPage.missionText: Our mission is simple yet meaningful: to improve the lives of our patients. Every treatment and procedure is carefully designed to deliver safe, natural-looking results and a personalized experience that respects and celebrates each individual's uniqueness.
aboutPage.visionText: We believe that beauty is not only about appearance, but also about confidence, well-being, and feeling comfortable in your own skin. Our vision is to become a trusted reference in aesthetic medicine by continuously embracing innovation, advanced technology, and the highest standards of care — without compromising on quality.
aboutPage.valuesExcellenceText: We are committed to the highest standards of medical excellence. Every procedure is performed with precision, expertise, and attention to detail, using advanced techniques, modern technology, and high-quality materials.
aboutPage.valuesCareText: Every patient is unique. From the first consultation to post-treatment care, we focus on creating a personalized experience where you feel heard, respected, supported, and valued.
aboutPage.valuesInnovationText: We continuously embrace innovation, combining advanced techniques and modern technology to provide safe, effective, and refined results.
aboutPage.valuesTransparencyText: We believe in clarity and honesty. From your first consultation to the final treatment plan, every step is explained clearly and transparently, without surprises.
aboutPage.valuesSocialText: We believe that beauty also means contributing positively to the world around us. We are committed to supporting meaningful initiatives and contributing to the well-being of our wider community.
aboutPage.whyTeamText: Our experienced team is dedicated to providing the highest standards of care, combining expertise, precision, and a patient-first approach to help you achieve your aesthetic goals.
aboutPage.whySafeText: Our facilities are designed to provide comfort, safety, and peace of mind, supported by modern technology and carefully maintained standards.
aboutPage.whyPersonalText: From your first consultation to your aftercare journey, our team is here to support you every step of the way. We take the time to understand your goals and create a treatment experience tailored specifically to you.
aboutPage.whyValueText: We believe that high-quality aesthetic care should be accessible without compromising on safety, expertise, or results. Our goal is to offer exceptional value while maintaining the highest standards of care.
aboutPage.whyExpText: The trust and satisfaction of our patients are at the heart of everything we do. The experiences and feedback of those who have chosen KIRA AESTHETIC reflect our commitment to care, quality, and excellence.
aboutPage.commitmentText: At KIRA AESTHETIC, we do more than provide aesthetic treatments. We create a journey. We listen, support, guide, and celebrate every step with our patients. Your confidence, well-being, and satisfaction are at the heart of everything we do.
aboutPage.contactText: We are here to listen, answer your questions, and help you explore your aesthetic goals. Contact us to schedule a consultation and discover how KIRA AESTHETIC can support you on your journey. Your transformation begins here.

faqs.question: What is the first step to any treatment?
faqs.answer: The first step is always a personal consultation with one of our specialists. We will discuss your goals, evaluate your case, and propose a personalized treatment plan for you.

faqs.question: How long is the recovery period for surgical procedures?
faqs.answer: Recovery time varies greatly depending on the procedure. During your consultation, our surgeon will provide you with detailed information about the expected recovery timeline, post-operative care, and any activity restrictions.

faqs.question: Are the treatments painful?
faqs.answer: We prioritize patient comfort. For surgical procedures, anesthesia is used. For non-surgical treatments, we use topical numbing creams and other techniques to minimize any discomfort. Most patients report minimal to no pain.

faqs.question: How can I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can book a consultation by calling us directly, sending us an email, or using the contact form on our website. Our team will get back to you promptly to schedule your appointment.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing options?
faqs.answer: Ja, we offer a variety of financing options to make our treatments more accessible. Please contact our administrative team to learn more about the plans available.

faqs.question: Will my nose look natural after the surgery?
faqs.answer: Our primary goal is a natural look in every surgery, something you will feel confident in and ready to get the world!

faqs.question: How much change can I expect in the appearance of my nose?
faqs.answer: From our hundred of patients stories, the change, being natural, will suit your face but it may or not be the thing everybody will catch on the fly. However your face will have everything in harmony.
